title: Cosmic Feline Trinity
description: Three cats sit on an ornate stone ledge: a black cat with glowing yellow eyes raising its paw, a grey tabby in the center, and an orange and white cat looking upward. Above them swirls a dramatic cosmic sky featuring a giant glowing green eye, vibrant nebulae in rainbow colors, lightning bolts, and floating magical orbs.
prompt: Three cats sitting on a decorative stone ledge under a dramatic cosmic sky, a solid black cat with glowing eyes raising its paw on the left, a grey tabby cat in the middle, and an orange and white cat on the right looking up. A giant glowing green eye watches from the swirling clouds filled with colorful nebulae, lightning bolts, magical energy streams, and floating glowing orbs, highly detailed fantasy scene.
